world.title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
world.summary: Megaspeed, the firm owned by ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's former lover Alice Huang, arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to the WSJ. Short seller Culper Research estimates Nvidia's actual China revenue share exceeds 20 percent, far above the officially reported 7 percent.

world.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
world.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton.

world.title: Ackman on Huang's Exit, Anthropic IPO Roadshow
world.summary: Bill Ackman, Pershing Square founder and CEO, says it's sad to see Jensen Huang leave Nvidia and he'll go on to do something great. Ackman also says he was impressed with the presentation given by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at the company's IPO roadshow event in New York. He speaks to Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee. (Source: Bloomberg)
